authority.scope: CPU design and documentation only; existing training continues unchanged

objective.focus: smooth zero-command standing and continuous handover under bounded execution uncertainty
objective.retained_scope: the original 22 nominal commands, including zero

source.baseline_evidence: 24 original Native conditions, 192/192; not new-condition or MuJoCo standing acceptance
source.selection: keep original4500 as default; compare later candidates only on the same immutable matrix and Plant, never select latest automatically
source.new_course_state: fresh explicit execution course; historical height/PD pass records do not initialize current qualification
source.teacher: frozen original4500 Actor; no optimizer; no control after the declared prefix

proposed_training.performance: inherit all currently enabled student_performance_v2 optimizations; grouped GPU evaluation and fixed-shape statistics

nominal_execution.spring_definition: independent physical torque = -scale * C(true_q); electrical compensation = C(PD_reported_q); final motor cap retained
nominal_execution.friction: inherit unchanged nominal effective material pair and combine rule; no friction DR in this experiment
nominal_execution.provenance: timings, leg armature, spring inverse model and wheel capability retain disclosed hypotheses; not hardware identification

allocation.nominal_motion_reduction: 21 commands in source order; first11 receive98 slots, last10 receive97
allocation.uncertain_initialization: within every uncertainty family, half direct student and half frozen4500 prefix100 policy intervals; initial_vx and pitch_rate are both zero in direct nominal-pose cases; prefix cases sample +/-0.05m/s and +/-0.10rad/s before the prefix only
allocation.handover: no reset or clearing of q/dq/previous/PD sensors/motor ring/response state at takeover; prefix is not LQR; learner masks exclude prefix Actor updates
allocation.RNG: reset-only independent per-env parameter counters; never consume policy sampling RNG

course.sampling: physical parameters are fixed for an episode; changes affect reset environments only
course.single_family_semantics: all nonselected uncertainty parameters stay nominal; prefix initialization is a separately identified factor
course.parameter_sampling: integer-uniform PD/transport ms; continuous-uniform common leg tau and common spring scale; independent family counters; common transport offset preserves ch2/ch5 asymmetry
course.promotion: one valid complete assessment: active focus AND all previously mastered boundary cases AND all22 nominal commands pass8/8; historical qualification alone is insufficient
course.behavior_regression_action: freeze expansion; continue the current distribution and retain failed tasks; do not reset model, Adam, RNG or counters
course.UNKNOWN: no promotion or new acceptance; not evidence of a behavior regression

reward.change: none in the first execution-uncertainty experiment
reward.inherit: the original4500 effective reward, including restored per-command width and smoothness mixtures, dense roll/leg Huber, spin differential/common/slip and transfer costs
reward.zero_scope: zero command for the full student-controlled episode; no additional motion-to-stop phase or rewritten old parking semantics
reward.retain_teacher_scope: source-qualified nominal034 old22 commands only, cohort/channel balanced; all uncertainty, biased observation and prefix samples excluded
reward.audit_before_runtime: actual formula SHA, raw/weighted/dt curves and derivatives for vx/vy/yaw/height/pitch/roll/geometry, width saturation, and smoothness-versus-recovery tradeoff; no promise of PPO convergence
reward.conditional_future_change: only propose a separately versioned zero-velocity broad/narrow or damping change if actual difficult-cohort diagnostics show lost discrimination; never hot-edit current or new active runs

critic.mass_and_friction: remain nominal constants while not randomized; future DR must populate physically effective values and preserve distinct mass/inertia/armature semantics
critic.required_diagnostics: per-purpose/family/command EV, return variance, value MSE, Actor/Critic gradient norm, PPO KL/clip and retention gradient contribution; no hard EV threshold blocks learning

evaluation.every100: checkpoint plus current training statistics and reward snapshot identity, explicitly not an independent checkpoint assessment
evaluation.holdout_isolation: two fixed joint tuples and yaw signs excluded from training parameter tuples/initialization support; do not select widths or tune reward on holdout outcomes
evaluation.early_level_scope: R04..R09 follow the current level boundaries; R10..R13 are report-only before E2 and required for final acceptance, never learning prerequisites
evaluation.mastered_anchor_replay: retain exact E0 R04..R09 parameter tuples after E1 adds wider bounds (6 cases); retain direct/prefix PD12 and PD16 after the PD upper bound increases (at most4 cases); deduplicate by full effective parameters, prefix, initial state, seed, windows and Plant, not by XY or stage label

standing_target_gates_proposed.antioscillation: inherit current absolute wheel/leg target-delta and request gates; also report high-frequency actual dq/body-rate/contact spectra, never infer resonance from 100Hz data alone

evaluation.nominal_motion_gates: inherit original4500 command-specific full protocol, including actual yaw and rolling equality/common; posture and swing thresholds unchanged
evaluation.metrics_authority: target-specific height_tracking/current checks, same scoring windows and actual driver limit; old .34-derived legacy fields and cached quality flags are diagnostic only
evaluation.same_matrix_comparison: rank on a common condition identity set, same parameter tuple/seed/windows/Plant; stage-local best_overall is not a global capability claim
evaluation.selection: accepted only if every required current condition passes; separately retain best_robust, best_old_motion and best_joint without combining their capabilities
evaluation.absolute_and_relative: absolute gates AND nominal nonzero-motion MAE increase<=0.05m/s or rad/s versus same-condition source; zero uses its explicit absolute standing gates; source-failed new conditions remain learning targets, not admission failures
evaluation.zero_PPO_source_reuse: reuse only exact same Actor/Plant/protocol/parameter/window evidence; new-source conditions UNKNOWN allowed for smoke/formal; no mandatory repeat of an already verified full source matrix

calibration_and_later_DR.small_bias_first_action: future authorized fixed-policy diagnostics: Actor-only, PD/compensation-only, and common reported-q bias; do not silently add bias to this training distribution
calibration_and_later_DR.bias_dq_and_previous: static angle bias does not change physical dq; previous remains the actual PD-adopted target in its declared coordinate system, not measured wheel speed or a noisy/shadow value
later_order: small fixed encoder bias after split diagnostics and coordinate agreement
body mass/inertia +/-5 percent with consistent CoM and inertia updates
gyro/encoder white noise at actual packet rate

storage_and_observability.evaluation: all8 per-env compact gates/metrics; traces follow the established storage profile, no repeated arrays in JSON/reports
storage_and_observability.high_frequency_tail: selected source/candidate/failure only; at most1env, final2s at1kHz per selected condition, fixed buffer; no every-step host copy
storage_and_observability.notifications: bind actual owner only under the later execution authorization; no watcher added by this design
storage_and_observability.capacity_check: re-estimate at preparation using actual checkpoint/JSON/NPZ sizes and atomic write peak/terminal reserve; current free space is not reserved

implementation_gaps: new explicit course/reward binding has not been installed
per-env post-PD transport, tau and spring-scale sampling/readback under this course is not implemented
continuous direct/prefix cohorts and stage boundary sampler identities require runtime validation
promotion must check current retained and all mastered cases, not just new focus
cross-stage common-matrix selection and current target-specific summary fields require implementation
standing target gates and split-window oscillation diagnostics require a new assessment version
exact source restore, actual effect/queue/critic readback and new engineering smoke still require later authorized execution
smoke_contract: proposed5 updates4critic+1actor check finite data, true optimizer/save/readback and declared limited coverage only; failed standing ability never blocks formal learning
stop_policy: no behavior auto-stop; runtime/nonfinite/closure/identity/budget/storage protections remain; never restart an intentionally stopped chain
future_execution: only after implementation and CPU checks, fresh source/recipe identity and new explicit execution authorization; use existing supervisor, no second trainer or watcher
